exam_set.title: Practice Set 1
exam_set.description: Textbook Practice — Book 1, Chapter 16, Practice Set 1

questions.jp: エンタープライズアーキテクチャ（EA）を説明したものはどれか。
questions.romaji: Entāpuraizu ākitekucha (EA) o setsumei shita mono wa dore ka.

options.label: ア
options.jp: オブジェクト指向設計を支援する様々な手法を統一して標準化したものであり、クラス図などのモデル図によってシステムの分析や設計を行うための技法である。
options.romaji: Obujekuto shikō sekkei o shien suru samazama na shuhō o tōitsu shite hyōjunka shita mono de ari, kurasu-zu nado no moderu-zu ni yotte shisutemu no bunseki ya sekkei o okonau tame no gihō de aru.
options.en: A standardized set of methods supporting object-oriented design, used to analyze and design systems with model diagrams such as class diagrams.

options.label: イ
options.jp: 概念データモデルを、エンティティとリレーションシップで表現することによって、データ構造やデータ項目間の関係を明らかにするための技法である。
options.romaji: Gainen dēta moderu o, entiti to rirēshonshippu de hyōgen suru koto ni yotte, dēta kōzō ya dēta kōmoku-kan no kankei o akiraka ni suru tame no gihō de aru.
options.en: A technique that expresses a conceptual data model with entities and relationships to clarify data structures and relationships among data items.

options.label: ウ
options.jp: 各業務と情報システムを、ビジネス、データ、アプリケーション、テクノロジの四つの体系で分析し、全体最適化の観点から見直すための技法である。
options.romaji: Kaku gyōmu to jōhō shisutemu o, bijinesu, dēta, apurikēshon, tekunoroji no yottsu no taikei de bunseki shi, zentai saitekika no kanten kara minaosu tame no gihō de aru.
options.en: A technique for analyzing business operations and information systems through business, data, application, and technology architectures, then reviewing them for overall optimization.

options.label: エ
options.jp: 企業のビジネスプロセスを、データフロー、プロセス、ファイル、データ源泉／データ吸収の四つの基本要素で抽象化して表現するための技法である。
options.romaji: Kigyō no bijinesu purosesu o, dēta furō, purosesu, fairu, dēta gensen/dēta kyūshū no yottsu no kihon yōso de chūshōka shite hyōgen suru tame no gihō de aru.
options.en: A technique that abstracts business processes using four basic elements: data flows, processes, files, and data sources or sinks.

questions.explanation:
ELI5:
Imagine a company as a city that needs one coordinated improvement plan. The business map shows what work its people and departments perform. The data map shows what information that work needs, while the application map shows which software supports the work. The technology map shows the computers, networks, and other infrastructure that keep the software running. Improving only one department or system can make that small area faster while creating extra work or incompatibility elsewhere. Enterprise architecture looks across all four maps together before planning changes. Its goal is whole-company optimization: making the organization work better as a connected whole rather than improving one isolated system.

Technical breakdown:
Enterprise architecture models an organization through four architecture domains: business, data, application, and technology. The decisive phrase is 全体最適化, overall optimization. EA compares current and target states across these domains and guides coordinated change.

Japanese keywords to remember:
全体最適化 = zentai saitekika = overall optimization
ビジネス = bijinesu = business
データ = dēta = data
アプリケーション = apurikēshon = application
テクノロジ = tekunoroji = technology

Why the best solution works:
ウ names all four EA domains and the goal of reviewing the enterprise as a whole.

Wrong answer analysis:
ア:
This describes UML, a modeling language for object-oriented analysis and design.
イ:
This describes an ER model for data entities and relationships.
エ:
This describes a data flow diagram, not enterprise-wide architecture.

Memory trick:
EA = business, data, apps, tech viewed as one enterprise.

Correct answer: ウ

questions.jp: エンタープライズアーキテクチャの“四つの分類体系”に含まれるアーキテクチャは、ビジネスアーキテクチャ、テクノロジアーキテクチャ、アプリケーションアーキテクチャともう一つはどれか。
questions.romaji: Entāpuraizu ākitekucha no 'yottsu no bunrui taikei' ni fukumareru ākitekucha wa, bijinesu ākitekucha, tekunoroji ākitekucha, apurikēshon ākitekucha to mō hitotsu wa dore ka.
questions.en: Besides business, technology, and application architecture, what is the fourth enterprise architecture domain?

options.label: ア
options.jp: システムアーキテクチャ
options.romaji: Shisutemu ākitekucha
options.en: System architecture

options.label: イ
options.jp: ソフトウェアアーキテクチャ
options.romaji: Sofutowea ākitekucha
options.en: Software architecture

options.label: ウ
options.jp: データアーキテクチャ
options.romaji: Dēta ākitekucha
options.en: Data architecture

options.label: エ
options.jp: バスアーキテクチャ
options.romaji: Basu ākitekucha
options.en: Bus architecture

questions.explanation:
ELI5:
Enterprise architecture uses four coordinated maps. Business architecture maps the work, application architecture maps the software functions, and technology architecture maps the hardware and networks. The missing map describes what information exists, what it means, and how pieces of information relate. That is data architecture. Remember the set as work, data, software, and technology.

Technical breakdown:
The four EA domains are business architecture, data architecture, application architecture, and technology architecture. The question already supplies three, so the missing domain is data architecture.

Japanese keywords to remember:
四つの分類体系 = yottsu no bunrui taikei = four classification domains
データアーキテクチャ = dēta ākitekucha = data architecture
エンタープライズアーキテクチャ = entāpuraizu ākitekucha = enterprise architecture

Why the best solution works:
ウ completes the standard four-domain EA framework.

Wrong answer analysis:
ア:
System architecture is a broad design term, not the named missing EA domain.
イ:
Software architecture concerns software structure and is narrower than application architecture.
エ:
Bus architecture concerns hardware or integration topology, not a top-level EA domain.

Memory trick:
EA four: business, data, application, technology.

Correct answer: ウ

questions.jp: エンタープライズアーキテクチャを構成するアプリケーションアーキテクチャについて説明したものはどれか。
questions.romaji: Entāpuraizu ākitekucha o kōsei suru apurikēshon ākitekucha ni tsuite setsumei shita mono wa dore ka.
questions.en: Which statement describes application architecture within enterprise architecture?

options.label: ア
options.jp: 業務に必要なデータの内容、データ間の関連や構造などを体系的に示したもの
options.romaji: Gyōmu ni hitsuyō na dēta no naiyō, dēta-kan no kanren ya kōzō nado o taikeiteki ni shimeshita mono
options.en: A systematic representation of required business data, its relationships, and structure.

options.label: イ
options.jp: 業務プロセスを支援するシステムの機能や構成などを体系的に示したもの
options.romaji: Gyōmu purosesu o shien suru shisutemu no kinō ya kōsei nado o taikeiteki ni shimeshita mono
options.en: A systematic representation of system functions and configurations that support business processes.

options.label: ウ
options.jp: 情報システムの構築・運用に必要な技術的構成要素を体系的に示したもの
options.romaji: Jōhō shisutemu no kōchiku un'yō ni hitsuyō na gijutsuteki kōsei yōso o taikeiteki ni shimeshita mono
options.en: A systematic representation of technical components required to build and operate information systems.

options.label: エ
options.jp: ビジネス戦略に必要な業務プロセスや情報の流れを体系的に示したもの
options.romaji: Bijinesu senryaku ni hitsuyō na gyōmu purosesu ya jōhō no nagare o taikeiteki ni shimeshita mono
options.en: A systematic representation of business processes and information flows required by business strategy.

questions.explanation:
ELI5:
Picture a delivery company mapping one business task: taking an order and getting a parcel to a customer. Application architecture identifies which software functions support that task, such as order entry, route planning, and tracking, and shows how those functions fit together. A map of information fields and relationships belongs to data architecture. A map of servers and networks belongs to technology architecture. A map of the human work itself belongs to business architecture.

Technical breakdown:
Match each description to an EA domain. Data content and relationships are data architecture. Technical components are technology architecture. Business processes and information flows are business architecture. Therefore system functions and configurations supporting business processes are application architecture.

Japanese keywords to remember:
業務プロセス = gyōmu purosesu = business process
システムの機能 = shisutemu no kinō = system functions
構成 = kōsei = configuration

Why the best solution works:
イ connects business-process support to system functions and configurations, the scope of application architecture.

Wrong answer analysis:
ア:
This defines data architecture.
ウ:
This defines technology architecture.
エ:
This defines business architecture.

Memory trick:
Application architecture = which app functions support the work.

Correct answer: イ

questions.jp: 企業活動におけるBPM（Business Process Management）の目的はどれか。
questions.romaji: Kigyō katsudō ni okeru BPM (Business Process Management) no mokuteki wa dore ka.
questions.en: What is the purpose of BPM in corporate activities?

options.label: ア
options.jp: 業務プロセスの継続的な改善
options.romaji: Gyōmu purosesu no keizokuteki na kaizen
options.en: Continuous improvement of business processes

options.label: イ
options.jp: 経営資源の有効活用
options.romaji: Keiei shigen no yūkō katsuyō
options.en: Effective use of management resources

options.label: ウ
options.jp: 顧客情報の管理、分析
options.romaji: Kokyaku jōhō no kanri, bunseki
options.en: Management and analysis of customer information

options.label: エ
options.jp: 情報資源の分析、有効活用
options.romaji: Jōhō shigen no bunseki, yūkō katsuyō
options.en: Analysis and effective use of information resources

questions.explanation:
ELI5:
Imagine a restaurant repeatedly studying the trip from customer order to served meal. It measures waiting time, finds a bottleneck, changes the process, and measures again. BPM manages business processes through this continuing loop of design, operation, observation, and improvement. It is process care over time, not one dramatic replacement project. Therefore look for continuous improvement of how work flows.

Technical breakdown:
Business Process Management manages processes through a continuing cycle of design, execution, monitoring, analysis, and improvement. The goal is not a one-time redesign but continuous process optimization.

Japanese keywords to remember:
業務プロセス = gyōmu purosesu = business process
継続的 = keizokuteki = continuous
改善 = kaizen = improvement

Why the best solution works:
ア states BPM's defining purpose: continuous improvement of business processes.

Wrong answer analysis:
イ:
Effective management-resource use is a broad management or ERP objective.
ウ:
Customer information management and analysis are associated with CRM.
エ:
Analyzing and using information resources is associated with BI.

Memory trick:
BPM = process improvement loop.

Correct answer: ア

questions.jp: BPRを説明したものはどれか。
questions.romaji: BPR o setsumei shita mono wa dore ka.

options.label: ア
options.jp: 企業全体の経営資源の配分を有効かつ総合的に計画して管理し、経営の効率向上を図ることである。
options.romaji: Kigyō zentai no keiei shigen no haibun o yūkō katsu sōgōteki ni keikaku shite kanri shi, keiei no kōritsu kōjō o hakaru koto de aru.
options.en: Plan and manage enterprise-wide resource allocation effectively and comprehensively to improve management efficiency.

options.label: イ
options.jp: 顧客視点から業務のプロセスを再設計し、情報技術を十分に活用して、企業の体質や構造を抜本的に変革することである。
options.romaji: Kokyaku shiten kara gyōmu no purosesu o saisekkei shi, jōhō gijutsu o jūbun ni katsuyō shite, kigyō no taishitsu ya kōzō o bapponteki ni henkaku suru koto de aru.
options.en: Redesign business processes from the customer's viewpoint and fully use IT to radically transform the company's nature and structure.

options.label: ウ
options.jp: 最強の競合相手又は先進企業と比較して、製品、サービス、オペレーションなどを定性的・定量的に把握することである。
options.romaji: Saikyō no kyōgō aite mata wa senshin kigyō to hikaku shite, seihin, sābisu, operēshon nado o teiseiteki teiryōteki ni haaku suru koto de aru.
options.en: Compare products, services, and operations qualitatively and quantitatively with the strongest competitor or a leading company.

options.label: エ
options.jp: 利益をもたらすことのできる、他社より優越した自社独自のスキルや技術に経営資源を集中することである。
options.romaji: Rieki o motarasu koto no dekiru, tasha yori yūetsu shita jisha dokuji no sukiru ya gijutsu ni keiei shigen o shūchū suru koto de aru.
options.en: Concentrate management resources on unique skills and technologies superior to competitors that can generate profit.

questions.explanation:
ELI5:
Suppose an old store makes customers visit three counters because that is how its departments were built. BPR asks what journey customers should have, then redesigns the work from scratch—perhaps one digital request replaces all three counters. This is radical process rebuilding, often enabled by IT, not a small adjustment to the old steps. ERP integrates resources, benchmarking compares with leaders, and core-competence strategy focuses attention on what the company does best. The clue for BPR is fundamental redesign from the customer's viewpoint.

Technical breakdown:
Business Process Re-engineering radically redesigns core business processes to achieve dramatic gains in cost, quality, service, and speed. Decisive wording includes 顧客視点, 再設計, and 抜本的に変革.

Japanese keywords to remember:
顧客視点 = kokyaku shiten = customer viewpoint
再設計 = saisekkei = redesign
抜本的に変革 = bapponteki ni henkaku = radically transform

Why the best solution works:
イ describes customer-focused process redesign, strong IT use, and radical organizational change.

Wrong answer analysis:
ア:
This describes ERP, integrated planning and management of enterprise resources.
ウ:
This describes benchmarking against leading organizations.
エ:
This describes focusing on core competence.

Memory trick:
BPR = break process, rebuild radically.

Correct answer: イ

questions.jp: 自社の経営課題である人手不足の解消などを目標とした業務革新を進めるために活用する、RPAの事例はどれか。
questions.romaji: Jisha no keiei kadai de aru hitode busoku no kaishō nado o mokuhyō to shita gyōmu kakushin o susumeru tame ni katsuyō suru, RPA no jirei wa dore ka.
questions.en: Which example uses RPA to advance business innovation aimed at addressing a company's labor shortage?

options.label: ア
options.jp: 業務システムなどのデータ入力、照合のような標準化された定型作業を、事務職員の代わりにソフトウェアで自動的に処理する。
options.romaji: Gyōmu shisutemu nado no dēta nyūryoku, shōgō no yō na hyōjunka sareta teikei sagyō o, jimu shokuin no kawari ni sofutowea de jidōteki ni shori suru.
options.en: Use software to automatically perform standardized routine work such as data entry and matching in business systems instead of office staff.

options.label: イ
options.jp: 製造ラインで部品の組立てに従事していた作業員の代わりに組立作業用ロボットを配置する。
options.romaji: Seizō rain de buhin no kumitate ni jūji shite ita sagyōin no kawari ni kumitate sagyō-yō robotto o haichi suru.
options.en: Place an assembly robot on a manufacturing line instead of a worker who assembled parts.

options.label: ウ
options.jp: 人が接客して販売を行っていた店舗を、ICタグ、画像解析のためのカメラ、電子決済システムによる無人店舗に置き換える。
options.romaji: Hito ga sekkyaku shite hanbai o okonatte ita tenpo o, IC tagu, gazō kaiseki no tame no kamera, denshi kessai shisutemu ni yoru mujin tenpo ni okikaeru.
options.en: Replace a staffed retail store with an unmanned store using IC tags, image-analysis cameras, and electronic payment.

options.label: エ
options.jp: フォークリフトなどを用いて人の操作で保管商品を搬入・搬出していたものを、コンピュータ制御で無人化した自動倉庫システムに置き換える。
options.romaji: Fōkurifuto nado o mochiite hito no sōsa de hokan shōhin o hanyū hanshutsu shite ita mono o, konpyūta seigyo de mujinka shita jidō sōko shisutemu ni okikaeru.
options.en: Replace human-operated forklift storage handling with a computer-controlled unmanned automated warehouse.

questions.explanation:
ELI5:
RPA is a software robot sitting at a computer, not a metal robot on a factory floor. It can repeat rule-based screen work such as copying form data, entering it into a system, and checking two records for a match. Those repetitive clerical tasks consume staff time and are good candidates for automation during a labor shortage. Factory arms, cashierless-store sensors, and warehouse machines automate physical activity instead. Ask whether software is imitating routine office clicks and keystrokes.

Technical breakdown:
Robotic Process Automation automates rule-based, standardized clerical processes through software operating applications. Data entry and reconciliation are classic RPA targets. Physical industrial robots and automated facilities are different automation categories.

Japanese keywords to remember:
定型作業 = teikei sagyō = routine work
データ入力 = dēta nyūryoku = data entry
照合 = shōgō = matching
ソフトウェア = sofutowea = software

Why the best solution works:
ア automates repeatable office-screen work with software in place of clerical staff, exactly the RPA model.

Wrong answer analysis:
イ:
This is physical industrial-robot automation.
ウ:
This is an unmanned retail system combining sensors, cameras, and payments.
エ:
This is physical logistics automation through an automated warehouse.

Memory trick:
RPA = robot in the PC, not robot on the floor.

Correct answer: ア

questions.jp: BPOを説明したものはどれか。
questions.romaji: BPO o setsumei shita mono wa dore ka.

options.label: ア
options.jp: 自社ではサーバを所有せずに、通信事業者などが保有するサーバの処理能力や記憶容量の一部を借りてシステムを運用することである。
options.romaji: Jisha de wa sāba o shoyū sezu ni, tsūshin jigyōsha nado ga hoyū suru sāba no shori nōryoku ya kioku yōryō no ichibu o karite shisutemu o un'yō suru koto de aru.
options.en: Operate a system by renting part of a provider's server processing and storage capacity instead of owning a server.

options.label: イ
options.jp: 自社ではソフトウェアを所有せずに、外部の専門業者が提供するソフトウェアの機能をネットワーク経由で活用することである。
options.romaji: Jisha de wa sofutowea o shoyū sezu ni, gaibu no senmon gyōsha ga teikyō suru sofutowea no kinō o nettowāku keiyu de katsuyō suru koto de aru.
options.en: Use software functions provided by an outside specialist over a network instead of owning the software.

options.label: ウ
options.jp: 自社の管理部門やコールセンターなど特定部門の業務プロセス全般を、業務システムの運用などと一体として外部の専門業者に委託することである。
options.romaji: Jisha no kanri bumon ya kōru sentā nado tokutei bumon no gyōmu purosesu zenpan o, gyōmu shisutemu no un'yō nado to ittai to shite gaibu no senmon gyōsha ni itaku suru koto de aru.
options.en: Outsource the full business processes of a specific department, such as administration or a call center, together with operation of its business systems, to an outside specialist.

options.label: エ
options.jp: 自社よりも人件費が安い派遣会社の社員を活用することによって、ソフトウェア開発の費用を低減させることである。
options.romaji: Jisha yori mo jinkenhi ga yasui haken gaisha no shain o katsuyō suru koto ni yotte, sofutowea kaihatsu no hiyō o teigen saseru koto de aru.
options.en: Reduce software development costs by using temporary-agency staff with lower labor costs.

questions.explanation:
ELI5:
Imagine hiring a specialist company to run the entire call-center operation: people, daily procedure, and supporting system. That transfers responsibility for a complete business process, which is BPO. Renting a server supplies infrastructure, using an online application supplies software, and borrowing workers supplies labor. None of those alone hands over ownership of the end-to-end process. The key boundary is the whole process, not one resource inside it.

Technical breakdown:
Business Process Outsourcing transfers responsibility for planning and operating a defined business process to an external provider. The scope can combine people, workflow, and supporting systems. Outsourcing only infrastructure, software access, or low-cost staff is not BPO.

Japanese keywords to remember:
業務プロセス全般 = gyōmu purosesu zenpan = entire business process
外部の専門業者 = gaibu no senmon gyōsha = external specialist
委託する = itaku suru = outsource

Why the best solution works:
ウ delegates an entire departmental process together with system operation to a specialist provider.

Wrong answer analysis:
ア:
This describes rented server or hosting infrastructure.
イ:
This describes SaaS.
エ:
This describes staff augmentation, not outsourcing responsibility for a complete process.

Memory trick:
BPO = business process goes outside.

Correct answer: ウ

questions.jp: ワークフローシステムを用いて業務改善を行ったとき、期待できる効果として適切なものはどれか。
questions.romaji: Wākufurō shisutemu o mochiite gyōmu kaizen o okonatta toki, kitai dekiru kōka to shite tekisetsu na mono wa dore ka.
questions.en: Which effect can be expected when improving work with a workflow system?

options.label: ア
options.jp: 顧客の購入金額に応じて、割引などのサービスを提供できる。
options.romaji: Kokyaku no kōnyū kingaku ni ōjite, waribiki nado no sābisu o teikyō dekiru.
options.en: Provide discounts and other services according to customer purchase amounts.

options.label: イ
options.jp: 自社と取引先とのデータ交換の標準規約が提供できる。
options.romaji: Jisha to torihikisaki to no dēta kōkan no hyōjun kiyaku ga teikyō dekiru.
options.en: Provide a standard protocol for data exchange between the company and trading partners.

options.label: ウ
options.jp: 書類の申請から決裁に至る事務手続の処理速度が上がる。
options.romaji: Shorui no shinsei kara kessai ni itaru jimu tetsuzuki no shori sokudo ga agaru.
options.en: Increase the processing speed of administrative procedures from document application through approval.

options.label: エ
options.jp: 保管する商品の倉庫内での搬入搬出作業の自動化が可能となる。
options.romaji: Hokan suru shōhin no sōko-nai de no hanyū hanshutsu sagyō no jidōka ga kanō to naru.
options.en: Automate moving stored goods into and out of a warehouse.

questions.explanation:
ELI5:
A paper approval is like a package passed from desk to desk: it can wait, get lost, or leave everyone unsure where it is. A workflow system acts like a tracked conveyor belt, automatically sending each electronic request to the next approver and recording its status. Less manual carrying and searching means the path from application to approval becomes faster. Customer discounts, company-to-company data formats, and warehouse robots solve different kinds of work. Follow the document's route to recognize workflow.

Technical breakdown:
Workflow systems define, route, track, and record document-centered work among participants. Automating the application-to-approval route reduces handoffs, waiting, and status-search time, increasing administrative processing speed.

Japanese keywords to remember:
ワークフローシステム = wākufurō shisutemu = workflow system
申請 = shinsei = application
決裁 = kessai = approval
処理速度 = shori sokudo = processing speed

Why the best solution works:
ウ describes electronic routing and approval, the core work automated by a workflow system.

Wrong answer analysis:
ア:
Purchase-based discounts are a CRM or sales-promotion function.
イ:
Standard intercompany data exchange is EDI.
エ:
Warehouse movement automation needs logistics equipment and control systems.

Memory trick:
Workflow = route requests to approval faster.

Correct answer: ウ
